name: Adelaide University A R Riddle Grant
summary: One-off grant for Adelaide University students in the final semester of Honours or postgraduate coursework who are in financial hardship.
key: Total value $3,000, as a one-off payment; the annual value varies with funds available.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent Humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen
In the final semester of an Honours year or Postgraduate Coursework program
Must show financial need or hardship with supporting documents
how: Contact AUSA Student Care before applying to arrange a short interview: (08) 8313 5430 or ausa.studentcare@adelaide.edu.au

source.label: Adelaide University: A R Riddle Grant

evidence.quote: The annual value of the grant varies depending on the funds available and the number and merit of applications received.
Applicants must contact Student Care before applying to arrange a short interview.
